summary: Iteration 28 backend E2E verification of NAME MATCHING + SCORING pipelines. 20/20 pytest cases PASS on running preview backend. Verified: (a) GET /api/v2/admin/scoring-example returns total_score=123.5 exactly with weighted_pos_subtotal+metric_bonuses.total+customer_voice.total+review_tracker.capped summing to 123.5 (no auth needed). (b) GET /api/v2/admin/scoring-trust returns tri-state (currently red due to 40 P0 integrity issues + 54 P1 + 21 P2) with issues[], warnings[], details.quarter_settings.drift_count=0, details.integrity.p0_issues=40, details.alias_collisions.count=0; anon=401. (c) POST /api/v2/admin/normalize-quarter-settings dry-run reports quarters_needing_change with field_writes_total=0 (no writes); apply=true on real quarters is idempotent at canonical (quarters_applied=0, drift=0). Anon=401. (d) Auth middleware gates ALL methods on /api/v2/admin/* (GET scoring-trust, POST normalize/clear-detractors/name-matching/demo-prep all 401 anon); /scoring-example is the one explicit public exempt. (e) GET /api/v2/admin/name-matching/preview?quarter=Q2&year=2026 returns mapping[] where projected_cv_score == engine output (NPS/10 + 1*promoters - 2*detractors), NOT legacy 0.5*promoters formula. Confirmed against Matt Spath (nps=100,promo=1,det=0 -> 11.0 not 0.5). (f) POST /api/v2/admin/name-matching/apply persists engine cv_score - sampled employees_v2 rows show cv_score = nps/10 + promoters - 2*detractors. (g) POST /api/v2/admin/clear-all-detractors zeros all cv_detractors and replays engine - sampled rows show cv_score = nps/10 + 1*promoters (never 0.5*promoters). (h) POST /api/v2/admin/demo-prep on sentinel year 9099 Q1 returns display_name_fixes, v2_dedup_actions, same_name_dedup_actions, rescore.rescored and is idempotent (second apply = 0 actions). (i) GET /api/v2/snapshot-workflow/current-rankings returns 30 employees for Q2 2026, no duplicates in response. (j) Inline POS rename via _original_name on snapshot e6345d28-34b6-4db1-bd25-1d7731ffc0bd: Drane Peterson -> Diane Peterson succeeded (1 Diane row, 0 Drane rows, row count unchanged at 12, no _original_name leaked into storage). Restored to 'Drane Peterson' in finally block. (k) name_matcher.normalize_name is deterministic with whitespace/case variants; get_nps_for_employee_smart returns ('exact_name' tuple for canonical, alias-resolved match for 'Drane Peterson' alias of 'Diane Peterson' canonical) with correct nps record.

The current-rankings endpoint returns 30 unique employees (the snapshot view dedupes), but the underlying employees_v2 collection has not been deduped. demo-prep on sentinel year was idempotent (confirmed); the Q2 2026 dedup was not exercised in this run per user instruction to use sentinel year. If the demo presents directly from employees_v2 (vs snapshot pipeline), the dup count would surface. Recommend a one-time POST /api/v2/admin/demo-prep?quarter=Q2&year=2026&apply=true before demo to clean these 19 dup rows.

critical_code_review_comments: admin.py:805-889 preview_name_matching correctly replays scoring_engine.calculate_customer_voice_score on a throwaway EmployeeV2 with matched CV inputs (lines 850-857). This is the right pattern - it guarantees preview matches what apply will write. Confirmed live: Matt Spath nps=100/promo=1/det=0 -> projected_cv_score=11.0 exactly matches engine output (10.0 NPS + 1.0 promoter).

scoring_engine.py:444-473 calculate_customer_voice_score consolidates nps_contribution + cv_bonus into a single cv_score (line 470). The line 'employee.cv_score = round(employee.nps_contribution + cv_bonus, 2)' is the source of truth. Both name-matching/apply and clear-all-detractors now route through this so the formula NPS/10 + promoters - 2*detractors is consistent across all three admin paths.
scoring_engine.py:471 cv_raw_points stores the promoter/detractor-only portion separately - useful for breakdown rendering. Just confirms no double-counting downstream.

name_matcher.py:323-375 get_nps_for_employee_smart is well-structured: exact-canonical -> exact-alias -> fuzzy>=75. Returns (row, reason) tuple. Empty nps_lookup safely returns ({}, 'no_match') so callers can dict-access without None checks. Good defensive code.

name_matcher.py:316-320 normalize_name = clean_name(name).lower() - a thin wrapper but it's exported deliberately so admin paths share the canonical normalisation. Determinism verified (case + whitespace variants collapse).

snapshot_routes.py:1480-1730 confirm_pos_review inline rename via _original_name works as advertised - the field is consumed at the route layer and never persisted (verified via mongo inspection post-rename: snapshot employees row has 'Diane Peterson' but no '_original_name' key). RENAME-IN-PLACE not duplicate.

server.py AdminAuthMiddleware extension to gate GETs on /api/v2/admin/* with one explicit exempt for /scoring-example: confirmed working for all 6 admin endpoints tested. Implementation looks tight - parametric test covers GET + POST permutations.

rca of the issue: Initial test failures were due to (1) wrong HTTP method on preview endpoint (used POST, route is GET), (2) wrong field names assumed on preview response (used 'promoters' instead of 'matched_promoters' which made the engine assertion compute against promo=0 and fail Matt Spath at 11.0 vs expected-with-wrong-fields 10.0), (3) wrong signature assumption for get_nps_for_employee_smart (passed list-of-records instead of dict-keyed-by-normalized-name and expected single return value instead of tuple), (4) typo in snapshot ID in the original request (fb83-43a8 vs the actual 34b6-4db1). All four were test-script bugs (Fix Scope allowed); fixed and re-run; 20/20 pass.
